commercial_product.note: Alcon is a global ophthalmology leader with two segments: Surgical (IOLs, vitreoretinal, cataract equipment) and Vision Care (contact lenses, ocular health). Recent FDA approval: TRYPTYR (acoltremon, formerly AR-15512) ophthalmic solution 0.003% for Dry Eye Disease (TRPM8 receptor agonist). Other approved pharmaceuticals from Aerie acquisition: Rocklatan, Rhopressa (glaucoma).

excluded_partner_owned: Investigator-initiated and academic-led studies where Alcon is only a collaborator (e.g., NCT00211315 lead by Manhattan Eye Ear & Throat Hospital).
